<function name="GetShouldServerRagdoll" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns if entity should create a server ragdoll on death or a client one.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true if ragdoll will be created on server, false if on client</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
